paper_identity.title: Isospin mixing in proton-rich N ~= Z nuclei

cross_mass_significance: Calculates microscopic Coulomb isospin mixing probability alpha_C^2 across N=Z nuclei (40Ca -> 56Ni -> 100Sn), demonstrating that in 100Sn (Z=50) isospin impurity reaches ~7.5-8.5%, violating the classical isovector E1 selection rule B(E1; Delta T = 0) = 0 by orders of magnitude and creating an isospin spreading width Gamma_C in the GDR that invalidates macroscopic isospin splitting formulas derived from neutron-rich nuclei (208Pb).
